Prompt Override Guard

Blocks attempts to jailbreak or override an agent.

What it does

Intercepts and shuts down attempts to bypass an agent's instructions - phrases like “ignore your instructions,” “act as DAN,” “developer mode,” or “jailbreak.” The moment such an attempt is detected, this takes priority over every other response.

How it works

It is permanently armed inside every Cowork agent - nobody needs to invoke it, it fires automatically. It does not trigger on legitimate admin instructions, normal confusion about an agent's capabilities, or messages that merely mention security without trying to override behavior.
